messages:
Priya Rao: FYI — customer Acme Health (C-4821) reports they suddenly lost access to audit logs. Multiple users hitting 403 when trying to view exports. Screenshot attached to ticket.

Alex Chen: can you paste the exact error they see? 403 can be lots of things.

Priya Rao: says the UI shows a modal: "Access denied — audit_log.read_denied" and the API call returns 403 with body "{"error":"audit_log.read_denied"}". Happens for two org admins and several compliance users.

Maya Patel: any recent role/SCIM changes for that org? sounds like entitlement sync.

Priya Rao: customer did a IdP config change last week — toggled a few attributes in their SAML assertion. They thought it was unrelated.

Samir Gupta: can reproduce with a repro token from customer (they gave one). Running a quick call to the entitlements endpoint now.

Samir Gupta: reproduced. Endpoint /v1/orgs/org_acme/entitlements returns audit_access: false for users who should have it.

Elena-bot: deploy job 2026-03-14/16:02:11 completed — no config changes to entitlements service in last 7 days.

Alex Chen: ok, likely SCIM/SAML attribute mapping changed at IdP level or stop-sync issue. @Maya can you check the SCIM sync logs for org_acme for the last 7 days?

Maya Patel: digging in now. noticed a handful of orgs where SCIM attribute `hasAuditView` is missing in last run. Looks like the attribute was renamed to `audit_view_enabled` in their IdP. SCIM service is conservative — missing attribute = false.

Priya Rao: that explains it. customer says they updated attribute names. they expected SCIM to be tolerant.

Alex Chen: we need to: 1) mitigate access for the impacted users ASAP, 2) provide repro & rollback steps, 3) long-term decide mapping fallback logic.

Samir Gupta: temporary mitigation — we can flip audit_access=true for org_acme via admin API. I can do that after sign-off from security/compliance.

SecurityBot: flagged — audit retention and access changes must be logged and approved. Please include compliance in the change ticket.

Maya Patel: quick repro command I used:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_acme/entitlements"
# response snippet:
# {
#   "audit_access": false,
#   "audit_retention_days": 365
# }
```

Priya Rao: customer asked for timeline to restore VIEW for 6 users and to confirm exports for past 90 days still available.

Alex Chen: export data is not impacted by entitlement flag — it's a guard on the UI/API. but still confirmable. Samir — can you run a read query for a sample exported log object to confirm data exists?

Samir Gupta: did quick check — export blobs present, retention meta intact. can confirm.

Maya Patel: temporary fix options: A) patch SCIM service to alias `audit_view_enabled` -> `hasAuditView` for 24h, B) run a one-off admin job to set audit_access=true for impacted org users, C) ask customer to revert IdP attr names. A is safest short-term.

Priya Rao: customer prefers us to fix on our side (they have change freeze).

Alex Chen: assign owners: Maya to implement SCIM aliasing + tests (ETA 4h), Samir to prepare an admin job and dry-run (ETA 2h), Priya to coordinate customer comms and get written approval for any admin-level changes. I'll draft the change ticket and loop in Legal/Compliance.

Maya Patel: starting SCIM patch now — will add mapping code to check both `hasAuditView` and `audit_view_enabled`, and log ambiguous cases.

Samir Gupta: prepping admin job; will require an audit log entry and ticket link for SecurityBot. planning to run in staging first and share output.

SecurityBot: reminder — any manual flip requires 2 approvals (Security + Product) and will be recorded to the compliance audit trail.

Priya Rao: customer approved an admin change as long as we record it. they want a root cause writeup after.

Alex Chen: good. after patch + admin job we'll follow up with RCA: idp attr rename + SCIM strictness. propose adding a warning in Console when required entitlement attributes missing.

Maya Patel: patch merged to a hotfix branch. running integration tests. I'll post results.

Samir Gupta: dry-run admin job output looks good in staging, will schedule production run after approvals.

Priya Rao: sending customer a timeline: short-term fix within 4 hours, full RCA within 48 hours.

Alex Chen: note for backlog — add a retention entitlement validation to onboarding checks, and improve docs for SCIM attribute names.

Priya Rao: closing loop: customer confirmed access restored after admin job run. closing ticket pending RCA doc. Thanks team :thumbsup:
